columnEnclosure.basis: 25 mm encasement space with at least 5 mm nominal clearance to the steel; south face stands 5 mm clear of the ground-floor trimmer and 6.5 mm clear of the first-floor joist. A separate 15 mm first-floor closing strip meets the existing partition face above the floor. A British Gypsum FireCase family provides a dimensional reference; required resistance, section factor, critical temperature, fixings and continuity at connections require project-specific selection. No fire rating is assigned.

groundDeckStrategy.status: Experimental coordination candidate; not approved for construction
groundDeckStrategy.basis: Replace the vehicle-loaded garage/utility deck south of the basement stair with a suspended RC slab on the perimeter RC walls and strengthened cinema walls. Retain timber floor north of the cinema, on a shorter main steel girder. All dimensions are experimental; reinforcement, load spreading, foundations and connection designs remain unverified.

loads.limitations: Wheel/axle/load distribution and simultaneous actions are not assigned from inaccessible normative text. Use separate UDL and concentrated-load sensitivities. 1 m strip is an explicit modelling assumption, not a verified effective width. Verify the actual van maximum gross/axle weights and future vehicles.

sources.title: IStructE UK National Annex publication schedule, 19 October 2026
sources.note: NA to BS EN 1991-1-1:2025 reported published 30 September 2026. Exact normative values not accessed; no claim that older draft values equal the published annex.

sources.title: BCSA second-generation Eurocode presentation
sources.note: Draft indicative UK choices only: F1 q3 kPa, axle30 kN, jack15 kN. Used to motivate upper sensitivity, not represented as the published standard.

sources.title: FP McCann hollowcore flooring
sources.note: Precast alternative requires supplier selection for actual spans, wall lines and vehicle loads, plus erection/crane access.

stripStudy.status: Flexural equilibrium sensitivity only; reinforcement is NOT selected
stripStudy.supportSpanBasis: Wall-centre to wall-centre simply supported strips. No continuity/fixity credit. A local wheel/jack is placed at midspan; vehicle axle pattern and transverse load distribution remain unresolved.
stripStudy.limits: No verified effective strip width, wheel/axle/jack positions, simultaneous actions, punching/one-way shear, cracking, long-term deflection, reinforcement continuity, anchorage, fire/exposure cover, bearing or construction-stage design. Required As is not an order or fixing schedule.

solidFloorStudy.basis: Short northern suspended ground-floor bays use 45 × 295 mm solid C24 at 400 mm centres. This uses about 43% less net timber than the earlier 95 × 245 mm option; both are compared in G02. Garage vehicle bays remain the separate G01 concrete-deck concept. Same FFL, ceiling datum and support network; joists are 5 mm shallower than the earlier 300 mm I-joist reservation. Experimental floor-load candidate; no complete floor-system approval.
solidFloorStudy.loadBasis: Assumed superimposed floor Gk 0.75 / 1.00 / 1.35 kPa, including a lightweight-partition allowance, plus joist self-weight at 4.2 kN/m³. Alternative Qk 1.50 / 1.50 / 2.00 kPa or one 2.00 kN midspan point on a single joist. The point and distributed cases are separate sensitivities, not simultaneous. Heavy walls, vehicles and plant are excluded from these timber bays. These are assumptions, not certified statutory bounds.
solidFloorStudy.limits: Limited C24 bending, shear and deformation screen: Emean 11000 / Gmean 690 N/mm²; SC1; kdef 0.6; psi2 0.3; gammaM 1.3; kcr 0.67; kh=ksys=1. Instant <= min(L/300,8 mm), final <= min(L/250,10 mm) are study targets. Vibration, restraint, floor diaphragm, service penetrations, bearing and compatible hanger/ledger fixings, fire/acoustic/moisture assemblies and the onward load route remain unverified. No construction approval.

supplierReference.supplier: Davies Timber / Cleveland Timber dimensional references
supplierReference.basis: UK supplier listing for 47 × 300 nominal / 45 × 295 finished C24; Davies page lists 4.8 m at £35.95 ex VAT. Listing is a supply benchmark, not a delivered quote or installed rate. Grade, moisture, durability, size/tolerance and availability require confirmation. The 44 × 293.5 mm case is an assumed smaller-section sensitivity, not a claimed supplier tolerance.

alternatives.label: Same-bay I-joist rate comparison only
alternatives.basis: Cost-rate comparison only. Manufacturer design, supply quote and exact section selection required.

solidFloorStudy.stockBasis: Illustrative 4.8 m C24 stock only: 20 mm trim per end, 10 mm oversize per part and 3 mm kerf. Reuses offcuts for blocking. Not a fabrication/cutting instruction; final lengths, connections and site dimensions must be verified. Supplier list price excludes delivery, labour, waste disposal, hangers, fixings and other floor components.

basementStairOpening.basis: Extend the low end of the opening to the main ground-floor girder. The new lining datum otherwise reduces clearance over the lower treads below 2 m. Remove the short end trimmer and two stub joists; extend the side trimmers to the steel. Keep all treads and floor levels; move the ground-level guard and landing light to suit.

limits: Geometric fit only. Board/resilient-bar/insulation system, fire/acoustic performance, fixings, service routes and penetrations require product-specific design. Deep beams, fixture attachment, door heads and stair clearances are separate checks. Finished floor levels and original retained lower-storey structure are preserved.
